summary: The Code on Social Security, 2020 was brought into effect on 21 November 2025 by the Ministry of Labour & Employment. Central Rules were notified on 8 May 2026. However, the aggregator contribution rate (1-2% turnover) and specific central funding mechanisms are pending final notification.
legalDisclaimer: Statutory framework active; central fund collection start date pending notification.

summary: Under the Central Rules, a platform gig worker qualifies for welfare scheme benefits after completing either 90 days of engagement with a single aggregator OR 120 days cumulatively across multiple aggregators in the preceding financial year. Same-day work across multiple apps is evaluated cumulatively on an indicative basis.
legalDisclaimer: Counts shown in Giggy are indicative estimates derived from your logs to help track eligibility.

summary: Preparations to link registered e-Shram gig workers to Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY (₹5 Lakh annual family cashless hospitalization) are in advanced implementation. Gig workers must hold an active e-Shram UAN and meet the engagement threshold to qualify for enrolment upon notification.
legalDisclaimer: Enrolment is in rollout phase; registration establishes future claim priority.

summary: Free national registration portal for unorganized and gig workers. Provides a 12-digit UAN card and includes ₹2,00,000 accidental death/permanent disability cover and ₹1,00,000 partial disability cover under PMSBY linkage.

Aggregators are required under emerging fair-work standards and state welfare board rules to provide written notice, transparent grounds, and a formal dispute resolution channel before terminating or deactivating partner IDs. Instant algorithmic blocks without notice can be formally appealed.
